import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem unique_lattice_coordinate_period (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p q : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + p) = f x)
    (hq : ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + q) = f x)
    (hind : ∀ a b : ℤ, (a : ℝ) * p + (b : ℝ) * q = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0) :
    ∀ d : ℝ, (∃ m n : ℤ, d = (m : ℝ) * p + (n : ℝ) * q) →
      ∃! z : ℤ × ℤ,
        d = (z.1 : ℝ) * p + (z.2 : ℝ) * q ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + d) = f x := by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨m, n, hmn⟩ := hd
  have hp_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p = (k : ℝ) * p + p := by push_cast; ring
      calc f (x + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p) = f (x + ((k : ℝ) * p + p)) := by rw [hcast]
        _ = f ((x + (k : ℝ) * p) + p) := by ring_nf
        _ = f (x + (k : ℝ) * p) := hp _
        _ = f x := ih x
  have hq_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * q) = f x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q = (k : ℝ) * q + q := by push_cast; ring
      calc f (x + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q) = f (x + ((k : ℝ) * q + q)) := by rw [hcast]
        _ = f ((x + (k : ℝ) * q) + q) := by ring_nf
        _ = f (x + (k : ℝ) * q) := hq _
        _ = f x := ih x
  have hsub_p : ∀ y, f (y - p) = f y := by
    intro y
    have h := hp (y - p)
    have : y - p + p = y := by ring
    rw [this] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hsub_q : ∀ y, f (y - q) = f y := by
    intro y
    have h := hq (y - q)
    have : y - q + q = y := by ring
    rw [this] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hp_neg_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (-(k : ℝ)) * p) = f x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      have hcast : (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * p = (-(k : ℝ)) * p - p := by push_cast; ring
      calc f (x + (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * p) = f (x + ((-(k : ℝ)) * p - p)) := by rw [hcast]
        _ = f ((x + (-(k : ℝ)) * p) - p) := by ring_nf
        _ = f (x + (-(k : ℝ)) * p) := hsub_p _
        _ = f x := ih x
  have hq_neg_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (-(k : ℝ)) * q) = f x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      have hcast : (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * q = (-(k : ℝ)) * q - q := by push_cast; ring
      calc f (x + (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * q) = f (x + ((-(k : ℝ)) * q - q)) := by rw [hcast]
        _ = f ((x + (-(k : ℝ)) * q) - q) := by ring_nf
        _ = f (x + (-(k : ℝ)) * q) := hsub_q _
        _ = f x := ih x
  have hp_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
    intro k x
    rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩
    · push_cast
      exact hp_nat t x
    · push_cast
      exact hp_neg_nat t x
  have hq_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * q) = f x := by
    intro k x
    rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩
    · push_cast
      exact hq_nat t x
    · push_cast
      exact hq_neg_nat t x
  have hd_period : ∀ x, f (x + d) = f x := by
    intro x
    calc f (x + d) = f (x + ((m : ℝ) * p + (n : ℝ) * q)) := by rw [hmn]
      _ = f ((x + (m : ℝ) * p) + (n : ℝ) * q) := by

          rw [this]
      _ = f (x + (m : ℝ) * p) := hq_int n _
      _ = f x := hp_int m _
  refine ⟨(m, n), ⟨⟨hmn, hd_period⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨hy_eq, _⟩ := hy
  have h_eq : (y.1 : ℝ) * p + (y.2 : ℝ) * q = (m : ℝ) * p + (n : ℝ) * q := by
    rw [← hy_eq, ← hmn]
  have h_zero : ((y.1 - m : ℤ) : ℝ) * p + ((y.2 - n : ℤ) : ℝ) * q = 0 := by
    have h1 : ((y.1 - m : ℤ) : ℝ) = (y.1 : ℝ) - (m : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
    have h2 : ((y.2 - n : ℤ) : ℝ) = (y.2 : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [h1, h2]
    have : ((y.1 : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)) * p + ((y.2 : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)) * q =
        ((y.1 : ℝ) * p + (y.2 : ℝ) * q) - ((m : ℝ) * p + (n : ℝ) * q) := by ring
    rw [this, h_eq, sub_self]
  have hind' := hind (y.1 - m) (y.2 - n) h_zero
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hind'
  have hy1 : y.1 = m := by omega
  have hy2 : y.2 = n := by omega
  exact Prod.ext hy1 hy2
